code='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    color = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 9))
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in points), max(r for r, _ in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in points), max(c for _, c in points)
    pattern = {(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in points}
    height, width = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for top in range(rows - height + 1):
        for left in range(cols - width + 1):
            if all(grid[top + dr][left + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in pattern):
                for dr, dc in pattern:
                    out[top + dr][left + dc] = color
    return out
'''
